description_en: Gets the details of a job
name: GetInstanceJob

GmtCreateTime.description_en: The creation time in UTC, in ISO 8601 format
GmtCreateTime.description_zh: 创建时间。ISO8601 格式的 UTC 时间
GmtCreateTime.title_en: 创建 UTC 时间，日期格式 iso8601
GmtCreateTime.title_zh: 创建 UTC 时间，日期格式 iso8601

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID. For example, if a job creates a custom role, this parameter returns the corresponding role ID
InstanceId.description_zh: 任务实例ID。例如在创建自定义角色的任务中是生成的角色ID

ReasonMessage.description_en: A message providing details about the job
ReasonMessage.title_en: 项目空间名称， region 内唯一
ReasonMessage.title_zh: 项目空间名称， region 内唯一

Status.description_en:
The status of the job. Valid values:

Creating: The job is being created.

Updating: The job is being updated.

Deleting: The job is being deleted.

Successful: The job completed successfully (a final state).

Failed: The job failed (a final state)
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。可取值：
Creating：创建中
Updating：更新中
Deleting：删除中
Successful：成功（终态）
Failed：失败（终态）

Type.description_en:
The job type. Valid values:

CreateWorkspaceCustomRole

UpdateWorkspaceCustomRole

DeleteWorkspaceCustomRole
Type.description_zh:
任务类型。取值：
CreateWorkspaceCustomRole
UpdateWorkspaceCustomRole
DeleteWorkspaceCustomRole
Type.title_en: 修改 UTC 时间，日期格式 iso8601
